degree_rationale: Three Griefs of inclined-of-heart powers — Mother of Life grieving over her children, First Man over his five sons, and a third who grieves. Treats the inward affective reception of cosmic suffering.
direction_rationale: Inward affective reception — pity, mourning, the heart's inclination. The most interior grief-reception.
grand_man_function: Spiritual grief-reception — the inward mourning of cosmic parents over bound children.
title: The Three Griefs of the Mother of Life over her bound children
